messages:
Rina (PM): Sprint ask  we need a concise launch canvas for Optimize features: batching, prefix caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts. Customers care about cost, mobile latency, and catching regressions quickly. I sketched three outcome buckets: Save $, Fast mobile, Catch regressions. Can we align on minimal gates by Friday?

Omar (Eng): Split work: runtime adaptive batching (infra) and SDK presets (safe). Runtime gives best $ but needs strict tail controls.

Faye (ML): Quant recommendations should be "recommended presets" with measured quality deltas per-model. Start with two Llama2 variants + one top community model. Build an eval harness first.

Carlos (Solutions): Sales asks for a one-line pitch + migration checklist. Console should expose 3 presets: conserve, balanced, low-latency. Include Dedicated notes.

Nora (SRE): Ops: require canary, per-route P95/P99 dashboards, token-cost telemetry, and automatic circuit breakers. Define rollback triggers (P99 spike or eval-alert surge).

Rina (PM): Proposed minimal gates: 1) Quant perf table for top-3 models; 2) Batching policy with canary + SLO override; 3) Prefix-cache correctness tests; 4) Eval-alert prototype + runbook. Thoughts?

Omar (Eng): Add concrete acceptance metrics: target token reduction %, mobile P95 ceiling, and allowed eval delta. I'll add numbers in the spec.

Faye (ML): Use relative thresholds per-customer; plan for human spot-checks in week 1.

Carlos (Solutions): I'll draft one-pagers for three pilot customers: HealthCorp (accuracy), Retail2 (cost), QuickApp (latency).

Nora (SRE): Rollout recipe: canary 5% -> 25% over 24-48h; automated rollback if eval-alert rate > 1.5% or P99 delta > 50ms. Add a tiny chaos test for cache correctness.

orch-bot: orch-bot created epic RDW-1801 and linked PRD https://redwood.internal/epics/RDW-1801 :rocket:

Rina (PM): Action items: Omar+Faye => tech spec + bench plan by Tue EOD; Carlos => pilot one-pagers; Nora => SLO guardrails + dashboards. Prioritization workshop Wed 11am. Post blockers here. :calendar:
